versos.grego: Λέγω οὖν, μὴ ἀπώσατο ὁ Θεὸς τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ; μὴ γένοιτο· καὶ γὰρ ἐγὼ Ἰσραηλείτης εἰμί, ἐκ σπέρματος Ἀβραάμ, φυλῆς Βενιαμείν.

controles.web: I ask then, did God reject his people? May it never be! For I also am an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.
controles.kjv: I say then, Hath God cast away his people? God forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.
controles.livre: Então pergunto: por acaso Deus rejeitou seu povo? De maneira nenhuma! Pois também eu sou israelita, da descendência  de Abraão, da tribo de Benjamim.

versos.grego: οὐκ ἀπώσατο ὁ Θεὸς τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ ὃν προέγνω. ἢ οὐκ οἴδατε ἐν Ἡλείᾳ τί λέγει ἡ γραφή, ὡς ἐντυγχάνει τῷ Θεῷ κατὰ τοῦ Ἰσραήλ;

controles.web: God didn’t reject his people, which he foreknew. Or don’t you know what the Scripture says about Elijah? How he pleads with God against Israel:
controles.kjv: God hath not cast away his people which he foreknew. Wot ye not what the scripture saith of Elias? how he maketh intercession to God against Israel, saying,
controles.livre: Deus não rejeitou seu povo, o qual desde antes conhecia. Ou não sabeis o que a Escritura diz de Elias? Como ele fala a Deus, contra Israel:

versos.grego: Κύριε, τοὺς προφήτας σου ἀπέκτειναν, τὰ θυσιαστήριά σου κατέσκαψαν, κἀγὼ ὑπελείφθην μόνος καὶ ζητοῦσιν τὴν ψυχήν μου.

controles.web: “Lord, they have killed your prophets, they have broken down your altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life.”
controles.kjv: Lord, they have killed thy prophets, and digged down thine altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life.
controles.livre: “Senhor, mataram os teus profetas, e derrubaram os teus altares; só eu fiquei, e buscam tirar-me a vida.”

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ τί λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ χρηματισμός; Κατέλιπον ἐμαυτῷ ἑπτακισχιλίους ἄνδρας, οἵτινες οὐκ ἔκαμψαν γόνυ τῇ Βάαλ.

controles.web: But how does God answer him? “I have reserved for myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to Baal.”
controles.kjv: But what saith the answer of God unto him? I have reserved to myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to the image of Baal.
controles.livre: Mas o que lhe disse a divina resposta? “Reservei para mim sete mil homens que não dobraram os joelhos a Baal.”

versos.grego: οὕτως οὖν καὶ ἐν τῷ νῦν καιρῷ λίμμα κατ’ ἐκλογὴν χάριτος γέγονεν·

controles.web: Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.
controles.kjv: Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.
controles.livre: Portanto, também agora no presente tempo ficou um remanescente, escolhido pela graça.

versos.grego: εἰ δὲ χάριτι, οὐκέτι ἐξ ἔργων, ἐπεὶ ἡ χάρις οὐκέτι γίνεται χάρις.

controles.web: And if by grace, then it is no longer of works; otherwise grace is no longer grace. But if it is of works, it is no longer grace; otherwise work is no longer work.
controles.kjv: And if by grace, then is it no more of works: otherwise grace is no more grace. But if it be of works, then is it no more grace: otherwise work is no more work.
controles.livre: E, se é pela graça, logo não é pelas obras; de outra maneira, a graça já não é graça..

versos.grego: Τί οὖν; ὃ ἐπιζητεῖ Ἰσραήλ, τοῦτο οὐκ ἐπέτυχεν, ἡ δὲ ἐκλογὴ ἐπέτυχεν· οἱ δὲ λοιποὶ ἐπωρώθησαν,

controles.web: What then? That which Israel seeks for, that he didn’t obtain, but the chosen ones obtained it, and the rest were hardened.
controles.kjv: What then? Israel hath not obtained that which he seeketh for; but the election hath obtained it, and the rest were blinded
controles.livre: Então, quê? O que Israel busca, isso não obteve; mas os escolhidos o obtiveram, e os demais foram endurecidos,

versos.grego: καθάπερ γέγραπται Ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Θεὸς πνεῦμα κατανύξεως, ὀφθαλμοὺς τοῦ μὴ βλέπειν καὶ ὦτα τοῦ μὴ ἀκούειν, ἕως τῆς σήμερον ἡμέρας.

controles.web: According as it is written, “God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear, to this very day.”
controles.kjv: (According as it is written, God hath given them the spirit of slumber, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear;) unto this day.
controles.livre: como está escrito: “Deus lhes deu espírito de insensibilidade;  olhos que não veem, e ouvidos que não ouvem; até o dia de hoje.”

versos.grego: καὶ Δαυεὶδ λέγει Γενηθήτω ἡ τράπεζα αὐτῶν εἰς παγίδα καὶ εἰς θήραν καὶ εἰς σκάνδαλον καὶ εἰς ἀνταπόδομα αὐτοῖς,

controles.web: David says,  “Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, a stumbling block, and a retribution to them.
controles.kjv: And David saith, Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, and a stumblingblock, and a recompence unto them:
controles.livre: E Davi diz: “A mesa deles se torne em laço e armadilha; em tropeço e retribuição para eles.

versos.grego: σκοτισθήτωσαν οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτῶν τοῦ μὴ βλέπειν, καὶ τὸν νῶτον αὐτῶν διὰ παντὸς σύνκαμψον.

controles.web: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see. Bow down their back always.”
controles.kjv: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see, and bow down their back alway.
controles.livre: Seus olhos se escureçam, para que não vejam, e suas costas fiquem constantemente encurvadas.”

versos.grego: Λέγω οὖν, μὴ ἔπταισαν ἵνα πέσωσιν; μὴ γένοιτο· ἀλλὰ τῷ αὐτῶν παραπτώματι ἡ σωτηρία τοῖς ἔθνεσιν, εἰς τὸ παραζηλῶσαι αὐτούς.

controles.web: I ask then, did they stumble that they might fall? May it never be! But by their fall salvation has come to the Gentiles, to provoke them to jealousy.
controles.kjv: I say then, Have they stumbled that they should fall? God forbid: but rather through their fall salvation is come unto the Gentiles, for to provoke them to jealousy.
controles.livre: Então, pergunto: por acaso tropeçaram para que caíssem? De maneira nenhuma! Mas pela queda deles a salvação veio aos gentios, para lhes provocarem ciúmes.

versos.grego: εἰ δὲ τὸ παράπτωμα αὐτῶν πλοῦτος κόσμου καὶ τὸ ἥττημα αὐτῶν πλοῦτος ἐθνῶν, πόσῳ μᾶλλον τὸ πλήρωμα αὐτῶν.

controles.web: Now if their fall is the riches of the world, and their loss the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fullness?
controles.kjv: Now if the fall of them be the riches of the world, and the diminishing of them the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fulness?
controles.livre: Ora, se a queda deles é o enriquecimento do mundo, e se o prejuízo deles é o enriquecimento dos gentios, quanto mais a sua plenitude!

versos.grego: Ὑμῖν δὲ λέγω τοῖς ἔθνεσιν. ἐφ’ ὅσον μὲν οὖν εἰμι ἐγὼ ἐθνῶν ἀπόστολος, τὴν διακονίαν μου δοξάζω,

controles.web: For I speak to you who are Gentiles. Since then as I am an apostle to Gentiles, I glorify my ministry;
controles.kjv: For I speak to you Gentiles, inasmuch as I am the apostle of the Gentiles, I magnify mine office:
controles.livre: Mas falo a vós mesmos, gentios; como sou apóstolo dos gentios, honro meu ministério,

versos.grego: εἴ πως παραζηλώσω μου τὴν σάρκα καὶ σώσω τινὰς ἐξ αὐτῶν.

controles.web: if by any means I may provoke to jealousy those who are my flesh, and may save some of them.
controles.kjv: If by any means I may provoke to emulation them which are my flesh, and might save some of them.
controles.livre: a fim de que, de alguma maneira, eu provoque ciúmes aos do meu povo,  e salve alguns deles.

versos.grego: εἰ γὰρ ἡ ἀποβολὴ αὐτῶν καταλλαγὴ κόσμου, τίς ἡ πρόσλημψις εἰ μὴ ζωὴ ἐκ νεκρῶν;

controles.web: For if the rejection of them is the reconciling of the world, what would their acceptance be, but life from the dead?
controles.kjv: For if the casting away of them be the reconciling of the world, what shall the receiving of them be, but life from the dead?
controles.livre: Pois, se a rejeição deles é a reconciliação do mundo, o que será sua admissão, senão vida dentre os mortos?

versos.grego: εἰ δὲ ἡ ἀπαρχὴ ἁγία, καὶ τὸ φύραμα· καὶ εἰ ἡ ῥίζα ἁγία, καὶ οἱ κλάδοι.

controles.web: If the first fruit is holy, so is the lump. If the root is holy, so are the branches.
controles.kjv: For if the firstfruit be holy, the lump is also holy: and if the root be holy, so are the branches.
controles.livre: E se as primícias  são santas, a massa  também é; e se a raiz é santa, os ramos também são.

versos.grego: Εἰ δέ τινες τῶν κλάδων ἐξεκλάσθησαν, σὺ δὲ ἀγριέλαιος ὢν ἐνεκεντρίσθης ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ συνκοινωνὸς τῆς ῥίζης τῆς πιότητος τῆς ἐλαίας ἐγένου,

controles.web: But if some of the branches were broken off, and you, being a wild olive, were grafted in among them, and became partaker with them of the root and of the richness of the olive tree;
controles.kjv: And if some of the branches be broken off, and thou, being a wild olive tree, wert graffed in among them, and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree;
controles.livre: Porém, se alguns dos ramos foram quebrados e separados, e sendo tu oliveira selvagem, foste enxertado no lugar deles, e feito participante da raiz, e nutrido pela boa oliveira,

versos.grego: μὴ κατακαυχῶ τῶν κλάδων· εἰ δὲ κατακαυχᾶσαι, οὐ σὺ τὴν ῥίζαν βαστάζεις ἀλλὰ ἡ ῥίζα σέ.

controles.web: don’t boast over the branches. But if you boast, it is not you who support the root, but the root supports you.
controles.kjv: Boast not against the branches. But if thou boast, thou bearest not the root, but the root thee.
controles.livre: não te orgulhes de ser melhor que os ramos. Mesmo se te orgulhares, não és tu que sustentas a raiz, mas sim, a raiz a ti.

versos.grego: ἐρεῖς οὖν Ἐξεκλάσθησαν κλάδοι ἵνα ἐγὼ ἐγκεντρισθῶ.

controles.web: You will say then, “Branches were broken off, that I might be grafted in.”
controles.kjv: Thou wilt say then, The branches were broken off, that I might be graffed in.
controles.livre: Tu, então, dirás: “Os ramos foram quebrados para que eu fosse enxertado.”

versos.grego: καλῶς· τῇ ἀπιστίᾳ ἐξεκλάσθησαν, σὺ δὲ τῇ πίστει ἕστηκας. μὴ ὑψηλὰ φρόνει, ἀλλὰ φοβοῦ·

controles.web: True; by their unbelief they were broken off, and you stand by your faith. Don’t be conceited, but fear;
controles.kjv: Well; because of unbelief they were broken off, and thou standest by faith. Be not highminded, but fear:
controles.livre: É verdade. Por causa da incredulidade eles foram quebrados, e tu, por causa da fé estás firme. Não tenhas orgulho, mas sim temor,

versos.grego: εἰ γὰρ ὁ Θεὸς τῶν κατὰ φύσιν κλάδων οὐκ ἐφείσατο, οὐδὲ σοῦ φείσεται.

controles.web: for if God didn’t spare the natural branches, neither will he spare you.
controles.kjv: For if God spared not the natural branches, take heed lest he also spare not thee.
controles.livre: pois, se Deus não poupou os ramos naturais, ele poderá não poupar a ti também.

versos.grego: ἴδε οὖν χρηστότητα καὶ ἀποτομίαν Θεοῦ· ἐπὶ μὲν τοὺς πεσόντας ἀποτομία, ἐπὶ δὲ σὲ χρηστότης Θεοῦ, ἐὰν ἐπιμένῃς τῇ χρηστότητι, ἐπεὶ καὶ σὺ ἐκκοπήσῃ.

controles.web: See then the goodness and severity of God. Toward those who fell, severity; but toward you, goodness, if you continue in his goodness; otherwise you also will be cut off.
controles.kjv: Behold therefore the goodness and severity of God: on them which fell, severity; but toward thee, goodness, if thou continue in his goodness: otherwise thou also shalt be cut off.
controles.livre: Olha, pois, a bondade e severidade de Deus; a severidade sobre os que caíram, mas a bondade de Deus sobre ti, se continuares na bondade; de outra maneira, também tu serás cortado fora.

versos.grego: κἀκεῖνοι δέ, ἐὰν μὴ ἐπιμένωσιν τῇ ἀπιστίᾳ, ἐνκεντρισθήσονται· δυνατὸς γάρ ἐστιν ὁ Θεὸς πάλιν ἐνκεντρίσαι αὐτούς.

controles.web: They also, if they don’t continue in their unbelief, will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.
controles.kjv: And they also, if they abide not still in unbelief, shall be graffed in: for God is able to graff them in again.
controles.livre: E também eles, se não continuarem na incredulidade, serão enxertados, porque Deus é poderoso para enxertá-los de volta.

versos.grego: εἰ γὰρ σὺ ἐκ τῆς κατὰ φύσιν ἐξεκόπης ἀγριελαίου καὶ παρὰ φύσιν ἐνεκεντρίσθης εἰς καλλιέλαιον, πόσῳ μᾶλλον οὗτοι οἱ κατὰ φύσιν ἐνκεντρισθήσονται τῇ ἰδίᾳ ἐλαίᾳ.

controles.web: For if you were cut out of that which is by nature a wild olive tree, and were grafted contrary to nature into a good olive tree, how much more will these, which are the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree?
controles.kjv: For if thou wert cut out of the olive tree which is wild by nature, and wert graffed contrary to nature into a good olive tree: how much more shall these, which be the natural branches, be graffed into their own olive tree?
controles.livre: Pois, se tu foste cortado da oliveira naturalmente selvagem, e contra a natureza enxertado na oliveira boa, quanto mais estes, que são naturais, serão enxertados na sua própria oliveira!

versos.grego: Οὐ γὰρ θέλω ὑμᾶς ἀγνοεῖν, ἀδελφοί, τὸ μυστήριον τοῦτο, ἵνα μὴ ἦτε ἐν ἑαυτοῖς φρόνιμοι, ὅτι πώρωσις ἀπὸ μέρους τῷ Ἰσραὴλ γέγονεν ἄχρι οὗ τὸ πλήρωμα τῶν ἐθνῶν εἰσέλθῃ,

controles.web: For I don’t desire you to be ignorant, brothers, of this mystery, so that you won’t be wise in your own conceits, that a partial hardening has happened to Israel, until the fullness of the Gentiles has come in,
controles.kjv: For I would not, brethren, that ye should be ignorant of this mystery, lest ye should be wise in your own conceits; that blindness in part is happened to Israel, until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in.
controles.livre: Não quero, irmãos, que ignoreis este mistério, para que não sejais sábios apenas a vós mesmos: o endurecimento veio em parte sobre Israel, até que a plenitude dos gentios tenha entrado;

versos.grego: καὶ οὕτως πᾶς Ἰσραὴλ σωθήσεται, καθὼς γέγραπται Ἥξει ἐκ Σιὼν ὁ Ῥυόμενος, ἀποστρέψει ἀσεβείας ἀπὸ Ἰακώβ.

controles.web: and so all Israel will be saved. Even as it is written,  “There will come out of Zion the Deliverer, and he will turn away ungodliness from Jacob.
controles.kjv: And so all Israel shall be saved: as it is written, There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob:
controles.livre: e assim, todo o Israel será salvo, como está escrito: “O Libertador virá de Sião, e afastará as irreverências de Jacó.

versos.grego: καὶ αὕτη αὐτοῖς ἡ παρ’ ἐμοῦ διαθήκη, ὅταν ἀφέλωμαι τὰς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν.

controles.web: This is my covenant to them, when I will take away their sins.”
controles.kjv: For this is my covenant unto them, when I shall take away their sins.
controles.livre: E este será o meu pacto com eles, quando eu tirar os seus pecados.”

versos.grego: κατὰ μὲν τὸ εὐαγγέλιον ἐχθροὶ δι’ ὑμᾶς, κατὰ δὲ τὴν ἐκλογὴν ἀγαπητοὶ διὰ τοὺς πατέρας·

controles.web: Concerning the Good News, they are enemies for your sake. But concerning the election, they are beloved for the fathers’ sake.
controles.kjv: As concerning the gospel, they are enemies for your sakes: but as touching the election, they are beloved for the fathers’ sakes.
controles.livre: Assim, quanto ao Evangelho, eles são inimigos, para benefício vosso;  mas quanto à escolha divina , são amados, por causa dos patriarcas.

versos.grego: ἀμεταμέλητα γὰρ τὰ χαρίσματα καὶ ἡ κλῆσις τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: For the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.
controles.kjv: For the gifts and calling of God are without repentance.
controles.livre: Pois os dons gratuitos e o chamado da parte de Deus não podem ser cancelados.

versos.grego: ὥσπερ γὰρ ὑμεῖς ποτε ἠπειθήσατε τῷ Θεῷ, νῦν δὲ ἠλεήθητε τῇ τούτων ἀπειθείᾳ,

controles.web: For as you in time past were disobedient to God, but now have obtained mercy by their disobedience,
controles.kjv: For as ye in times past have not believed God, yet have now obtained mercy through their unbelief:
controles.livre: Pois, assim como vós também antigamente fostes desobedientes a Deus, agora recebestes misericórdia pela desobediência deles,

versos.grego: οὕτως καὶ οὗτοι νῦν ἠπείθησαν τῷ ὑμετέρῳ ἐλέει ἵνα καὶ αὐτοὶ νῦν ἐλεηθῶσιν.

controles.web: even so these also have now been disobedient, that by the mercy shown to you they may also obtain mercy.
controles.kjv: Even so have these also now not believed, that through your mercy they also may obtain mercy.
controles.livre: assim também agora eles foram desobedientes, a fim de que, pela misericórdia que foi a vós concedida , eles também agora recebam misericórdia;

versos.grego: συνέκλεισεν γὰρ ὁ Θεὸς τοὺς πάντας εἰς ἀπείθειαν ἵνα τοὺς πάντας ἐλεήσῃ.

controles.web: For God has shut up all to disobedience, that he might have mercy on all.
controles.kjv: For God hath concluded them all in unbelief, that he might have mercy upon all.
controles.livre: porque Deus pôs todos debaixo da desobediência, a fim de ter misericórdia para com todos.

versos.grego: Ὦ βάθος πλούτου καὶ σοφίας καὶ γνώσεως Θεοῦ· ὡς ἀνεξεραύνητα τὰ κρίματα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀνεξιχνίαστοι αἱ ὁδοὶ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past tracing out!
controles.kjv: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!
controles.livre: Ó profundidade das riquezas, tanto da sabedoria como do conhecimento de Deus! Quão incompreensíveis são os seus juízos, e inimagináveis os seus caminhos!

versos.grego: Τίς γὰρ ἔγνω νοῦν Κυρίου; ἢ τίς σύμβουλος αὐτοῦ ἐγένετο;

controles.web: “For who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counselor?”
controles.kjv: For who hath known the mind of the Lord? or who hath been his counsellor?
controles.livre: Pois quem entendeu a mentalidade do Senhor? Ou quem foi o seu conselheiro?

versos.grego: ἢ τίς προέδωκεν αὐτῷ, καὶ ἀνταποδοθήσεται αὐτῷ;

controles.web: “Or who has first given to him, and it will be repaid to him again?”
controles.kjv: Or who hath first given to him, and it shall be recompensed unto him again?
controles.livre: Ou quem lhe deu primeiro, para ser por ele recompensado?

versos.grego: ὅτι ἐξ αὐτοῦ καὶ δι’ αὐτοῦ καὶ εἰς αὐτὸν τὰ πάντα· αὐτῷ ἡ δόξα εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας· ἀμήν.

controles.web: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things. To him be the glory for ever! Amen.
controles.kjv: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things: to whom be glory for ever. Amen.
controles.livre: Porque dele, por ele, e para ele, são todas as coisas! A ele seja a glória eternamente! Amém!
